content.text: Survey how billing-service and auth-service implement per-key rate limiting: algorithm, storage, headers returned. Summarize in a table.

src/limit/window.ts:8: // sliding window log, per-key timestamps in LRU
src/limit/window.ts:30: res.set('Retry-After', String(retryAfterSec)); res.status(429);

Survey complete:

| service | algorithm | storage | headers |
|---|---|---|---|
| billing-service | fixed window 100/min | Redis INCR + EXPIRE | X-RateLimit-Remaining |
| auth-service | sliding window log | in-memory LRU | Retry-After on 429 |

Recommendation: sliding window like auth-service, but keep counters in Redis so multiple replicas share state.
